```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# Vignette supporting the SMDM poster:
#   "Modeling Multiple Biomarkers in Precision Oncology:
#    How Ignoring Biomarker Correlations Can Reverse Clinical Conclusions"

```

```{r cohort, include=FALSE}
# Common complete-case cohort for all three biomarkers, so single vs joint
# models are compared on the SAME patients (isolates adjustment, not sample size).
req <- c("Age","sex","Rx","crp","tlr","tmb_braf","OSwk","Death","PFSwk","Progression")
d3  <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[, req]), ]
n3  <- nrow(d3)

bms      <- c("crp","tlr","tmb_braf")
bm_label <- c(crp = "CRP", tlr = "TLR (mediator)", tmb_braf = "TMB/BRAF")
dist_for <- list(OS = "weibull", PFS = "lognormal")   # matches para_models AIC choice
surv_lhs <- list(OS = "Surv(OSwk, Death)", PFS = "Surv(PFSwk, Progression)")
```

```{r forest-data, include=FALSE}
# Treatment x biomarker interaction, single-biomarker vs joint model.
# Parametric AFT time ratio = exp(interaction coef). TR > 1 => experimental
# treatment extends survival MORE in biomarker-positive (= predictive benefit).
get_int_row <- function(res, bm) {
  rn  <- rownames(res)
  hit <- rn[grepl(":", rn) & grepl(bm, rn) & grepl("Rx", rn)]
  if (length(hit) != 1) stop("Could not uniquely match interaction term for ", bm)
  r <- res[hit, ]
  c(est = r[["est"]], lo = r[["L95%"]], hi = r[["U95%"]])
}

forest <- list()
for (ep in c("PFS","OS")) {
  f_joint <- as.formula(paste0(surv_lhs[[ep]], " ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp*Rx + tlr*Rx + tmb_braf*Rx"))
  m_joint <- flexsurvreg(f_joint, data = d3, dist = dist_for[[ep]])
  for (bm in bms) {
    f_single <- as.formula(paste0(surv_lhs[[ep]], " ~ Age + sex + Rx*", bm))
    m_single <- flexsurvreg(f_single, data = d3, dist = dist_for[[ep]])
    rs <- get_int_row(m_single$res, bm); rj <- get_int_row(m_joint$res, bm)
    forest[[length(forest)+1]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, biomarker = bm_label[[bm]],
                                              model = "Single-biomarker",
                                              TR = exp(rs["est"]), lo = exp(rs["lo"]), hi = exp(rs["hi"]))
    forest[[length(forest)+1]] <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, biomarker = bm_label[[bm]],
                                              model = "Joint (correlation-adjusted)",
                                              TR = exp(rj["est"]), lo = exp(rj["lo"]), hi = exp(rj["hi"]))
  }
}
forest_df <- do.call(rbind, forest); rownames(forest_df) <- NULL
forest_df$endpoint  <- factor(forest_df$endpoint, levels = c("PFS","OS"))
forest_df$biomarker <- factor(forest_df$biomarker, levels = c("CRP","TMB/BRAF","TLR (mediator)"))
forest_df$model     <- factor(forest_df$model, levels = c("Single-biomarker","Joint (correlation-adjusted)"))
```

# Forest plot: single-biomarker vs joint modelling

```{r forest-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.2}
#| fig-cap: "Treatment x biomarker interaction (survival time ratio) for each candidate biomarker, estimated in single-biomarker models versus one joint correlation-adjusted model, in the same n=65 cohort. TR > 1 favours adding immunotherapy in biomarker-positive patients; the dashed line is the null. Single-biomarker estimates are systematically further from the null; joint estimates shrink toward it (most strikingly TMB/BRAF on OS: 1.47 -> 1.06). None reaches significance at this sample size."
p_forest <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(x = TR, y = biomarker, colour = model, shape = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.7, fatten = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ endpoint, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Single-biomarker" = "#C0392B",
                                 "Joint (correlation-adjusted)" = "#1F4E79")) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment x biomarker interaction\n(survival time ratio; >1 favours adding immunotherapy in biomarker-positive)",
    y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL,
    title = "Single-biomarker modelling overstates predictive value",
    subtitle = sprintf("Parametric AFT interaction estimates, METIMMOX (n = %d complete cases on all three biomarkers)", n3)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(p_forest)
```

```{r save-forest, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("figs"); if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
tables_dir <- here("tables"); if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(here("figs", "poster_forest.png"), p_forest, width = 10, height = 5.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
write.csv(forest_df, here("tables", "poster_forest_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Three-strategy cost-effectiveness analysis

```{r cea, include=FALSE}
# Override strategy/biomarker sets so model_fun + predictions include TLR.
get_strategies <- function() c("control","crp","tlr","tmb_braf")
get_biomarkers <- function() c("crp","tlr","tmb_braf")

m_os3  <- flexsurvreg(Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp*Rx + tlr*Rx + tmb_braf*Rx, data = d3, dist = "weibull")
m_pfs3 <- flexsurvreg(Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp*Rx + tlr*Rx + tmb_braf*Rx, data = d3, dist = "lognormal")

prev <- sapply(bms, function(b) mean(as.numeric(as.character(d3[[b]]))))
strategies_df3 <- data.frame(id = c("control", bms),
                             prevalence = c(1, prev[bms]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

preds3 <- generate_population_averaged_predictions(
  models = list(os = m_os3, pfs = m_pfs3),
  strategies_df = strategies_df3, data_complete = d3,
  time_points = seq(0, time_horizon, by = 1))

mk <- function(side, ep)
  setNames(lapply(bms, function(b) preds3[[b]][[paste0("biomarker_", side)]][[ep]]),
           paste0(bms, if (side == "positive") "_pos_" else "_neg_", toupper(ep)))
p_os3 <- c(list(control_OS = preds3$control$os), mk("positive","os"), mk("negative","os"),
           setNames(lapply(bms, function(b) preds3[[b]]$os), paste0(bms, "_weighted_OS")))
p_pfs3 <- c(list(control_PFS = preds3$control$pfs), mk("positive","pfs"), mk("negative","pfs"),
            setNames(lapply(bms, function(b) preds3[[b]]$pfs), paste0(bms, "_weighted_PFS")))

l_params_base3 <- l_params_base
l_params_base3$p_os  <- p_os3
l_params_base3$p_pfs <- p_pfs3
l_params_base3$p_crp      <- prev[["crp"]]
l_params_base3$p_tlr      <- prev[["tlr"]]
l_params_base3$p_tmb_braf <- prev[["tmb_braf"]]

res3  <- suppressWarnings(model_fun(l_params_base3, determpsa = "det"))
icer3 <- dampack::calculate_icers(cost = res3$Cost, effect = res3$Effect, strategies = res3$Strategy)

label_strategy <- c(control = "Standard of Care", crp = "CRP-guided",
                    tlr = "TLR-guided", tmb_braf = "TMB/BRAF-guided")
cea_tbl <- as.data.frame(icer3) %>%
  mutate(Strategy = label_strategy[as.character(Strategy)],
         NMB = Effect * WTP - Cost)
write.csv(cea_tbl, here("tables", "poster_cea.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r cea-display}
fmt_eur <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | !is.finite(x), "--",
                              scales::dollar(x, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1))
cea_display <- cea_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    Strategy,
    Cost = fmt_eur(Cost),
    QALYs = sprintf("%.3f", Effect),
    NMB = fmt_eur(NMB),
    Status = recode(Status, ND = "On frontier / optimal", D = "Dominated", ED = "Ext. dominated",
                    .default = Status)
  )

kable(cea_display,
      caption = sprintf("Three-strategy cost-effectiveness (joint model, n = %d, WTP = EUR %s/QALY)",
                        n3, format(WTP, big.mark = ",")),
      format = "html", align = c("l","r","r","r","l")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13) %>%
  footnote(general = c(
    "Comprehensive joint model: OS/PFS ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp*Rx + tlr*Rx + tmb_braf*Rx.",
    "TLR is a post-randomization mediator, included here only to illustrate the poster point.",
    sprintf("Prevalence: CRP %.0f%%, TLR %.0f%%, TMB/BRAF %.0f%%.",
            100*prev[["crp"]], 100*prev[["tlr"]], 100*prev[["tmb_braf"]]),
    "Utilities: CORRECT trial (UTILITY_SOURCE = 1). All guided strategies are dominated by standard care."),
    general_title = "Notes: ")
```
